version.description: Bumped on every edit; results record the version they used.

verified.description: Set by an admin after checking sources. User libraries (later) are never verified.

airframe.description: multirotor: hovers, climbs in place and turns on the spot. fixed-wing: needs airspeed above the stall, climbs and descends at limited angles and turns on a radius; the limits are in fixedWing. Without the field a drone is a multirotor.

cruisePowerW.description: Measured electrical power at cruise airspeed, sea-level ISA density.

powerDensityExponent.description: Measured exponent n in P = P0 (rho0/rho)^n; 0 means density is not applied. Never assumed.

climbPowerW.description: measured: power during climb at climbRateMps.

fixedWing.description: Flight envelope of a fixed-wing airframe, set to match its flight controller (INAV nav_fw_*, ArduPilot TECS and navigation parameters).

stallSpeedMps.description: Level-flight stall airspeed at the drone's mass, sea-level ISA density.

maxBankDeg.description: Bank angle the autopilot turns with (INAV nav_fw_bank_angle, ArduPilot ROLL_LIMIT_DEG); the turn radius is V^2 / (g tan bank).

maxClimbAngleDeg.description: Steepest climb the autopilot flies (INAV nav_fw_climb_angle, ArduPilot TECS_PITCH_MAX).

maxDiveAngleDeg.description: Steepest descent the autopilot flies (INAV nav_fw_dive_angle, ArduPilot TECS_PITCH_MIN).

loiterRadiusM.description: Radius of the circle the autopilot holds position on (INAV nav_fw_loiter_radius, ArduPilot WP_LOITER_RAD).
